headline: Quiet day; scores hold their ground
body: Another day without scored events. The only change came from older stories fading, worth a hundredth of a point here and there. Horizon Balance stays at -4.91. Enslaved God leads at 41.70, Conquerors follows at 27.83 and Self-Destruction sits third at 25.92.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
